I have farmed maize in Mulanje for many years, and I will use the fertilizer and hybrid seed I receive from the government subsidy program to feed my family. Because my coupon is meant for a smaller piece of land, I will spread those two bags across my 0.69 hectares, so the nitrogen will be less than what the extension worker recommends. My children and I will do most of the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves, but I will hire about ten days of ganyu when the ridging and weeding become too heavy for us. I do not spray chemicals or use irrigation because the rains usually come in good time here, and maize does not need those expensive things.
